verdict.rationale: Sketch offers a JavaScript Plugin API with a 'try it now' interactive playground (sketch-docs-4, sketch-docs-51) that shows runnable code examples, but this is a plugin/scripting API reference, not a broader interactive API reference tied to AI-native agentic exploration, and there's no confirmed OpenAPI/REST reference (probe of openapi.json paths returned 404s). missing for 10: a comprehensive REST/OpenAPI-style interactive reference, evidence of agent/AI-native discoverability of the API docs, independent confirmation of the runnable examples working end-to-end.
